record_title: Exact point-mass Walsh square functions and a correction to higher-order exponent sharpness
provenance: Exact analysis of the singleton test function used in Section 6.3 of arXiv:2609.09040v1, including a correction to its distinct-index higher-order lower-bound calculation and a repaired proof of the claimed exponent sharpness.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result concerns the singleton distinct-index square function and the exponent-sharpness step; it does not determine the optimal (p-1)-dependence, prove singleton extremality for the full operator norm, or re-audit the source preprint beyond the statements needed here. The identity is elementary and may occur in older Boolean-analysis literature under different notation, and recent unindexed corrections remain a residual risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
